FINAL ANSWER (data-grounded hypothesis): 100% of the studies in Experimental Economics were conducted in a lab setting — 18 out of 18.

Hypothesis: In the supplied meta-regression dataset, every one of the 18 Experimental Economics (project == 'ee') original studies was conducted in a physical lab rather than online. Using the approved indicator "lab setting := online.o == 0" (not conducted online), all 18 ee rows have online.o == 0, so the proportion in a lab setting is 18/18 = 1.00 (100%).

Supporting evidence (ee subset, 18 rows):
- online.o: {0: 18, 1: 0, NA: 0}
- online.r: {0: 18} (replications also all non-online — answer is robust to original-vs-replication reading)
